content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Vacancy 2026 – Post-Wise Details
content_sections.text: SBI has notified 207 tentative vacancies. The vacancies mentioned are indicative, and the Bank reserves the right to transfer selected officers to any of its offices, associates, subsidiaries, or other organizations, depending on the exigencies of service.

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Recruitment 2026 – Circle-Wise Vacancy
content_sections.text: For Relationship Manager–Team Lead, Investment Specialist, Investment Officer, VP Wealth, and AVP Wealth posts, candidates must indicate three different preferred Circles while applying. No request for change of Circle preference will be entertained at any stage, and if a candidate does not get their preferred Circle(s), their candidature may be considered for other Circles.

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: All qualification and experience criteria are reckoned as on 31-08-2026. Teaching and training experience will not be counted for eligibility, and experience of less than six months in any organization will not be considered.

rows.educational_qualification_mandatory: Graduate from a Government-recognized University/Institution (MBA in Banking/Finance/Marketing and CFP/CFA/NISM certifications preferred)
rows.post_qualification_experience_mandatory: Minimum 15 years in managing sales in Wealth Management/Retail Banking/AMCs, including at least 5 years leading a large team of Relationship Managers and Team Leads
Minimum 12+ years in relationship management, preferably in wealth management with leading banks/wealth firms/AMCs, including 5+ years leading a large team
Minimum 8 years in relationship management, preferably in wealth management; experience as a Team Lead preferred

rows.educational_qualification_mandatory: PG Degree/Diploma in Finance, Accountancy, Business Management, Commerce, Economics, Capital Markets, Banking, Insurance, or Actuarial Science, or CA/CFA
rows.post_qualification_experience_mandatory: Minimum 6 years of post-qualification experience as an investment advisor/counsellor/officer/product-team member in Wealth Management Firms/AMCs

rows.educational_qualification_mandatory: PG Degree/Diploma as above, or CA/CFA
rows.post_qualification_experience_mandatory: Minimum 4 years of post-qualification experience as above
Essential: 6 years in sales & marketing with leading banks/wealth firms/AMCs. Preferred: minimum 6 years as a Relationship Manager or similar role in wealth management

rows.educational_qualification_mandatory: Graduate (PG in finance/marketing/banking preferred; NISM V-A/XXI-A/CFP/CFA preferred)
rows.post_qualification_experience_mandatory: 3 years in sales & marketing with leading banks/wealth firms/AMCs, or 4 years as an SBI Wealth CRE. Preferred: minimum 3 years as a Relationship Manager or similar role in wealth management

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Age Limit (as on 31-08-2026)
content_sections.text: Maximum age indicated is for Unreserved category candidates; relaxation in the upper age limit is available to reserved category candidates as per Government of India guidelines.

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO CTC and Contract Period
content_sections.text: Annual CTC is negotiable and depends on the candidate's experience, current emoluments, and place of posting. All posts are eligible for Performance Linked Pay (0% to 45% of Fixed Pay) and an Annual Increment Band, based on performance rating as per the Bank's policy. The contract period is 5 years, renewable for another 4 years at the Bank's discretion, and can be terminated by either side with 2 months' notice or payment/surrender of 2 months' compensation in lieu. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Application Fee
content_sections.text: The application fee and intimation charges (non-refundable) are ₹750 for UR/EWS/OBC candidates; there is no fee for SC/ST/PwBD candidates. Fees must be paid online through the payment gateway integrated with the application, using Debit Card, Credit Card, or Internet Banking. The fee, once paid, will not be refunded or adjusted for any other examination or selection.

content_sections.heading: SBI SCO Selection Process
content_sections.text: Shortlisting: mere fulfilment of minimum qualification and experience does not entitle a candidate to be called for interview; the shortlisting committee decides the parameters and number of candidates called. Interview: one or more rounds of personal, telephonic, or video interview, carrying 100 marks; the qualifying marks are decided by the Bank. CTC Negotiation: conducted individually with shortlisted candidates, at the time of interview or after completion of the interview process. Merit List: prepared in descending order based on interview scores only; candidates tied at the cut-off mark are ranked by age, in descending order.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates should apply well before the closing date, 25-09-2026, to avoid last-minute technical issues. Hard copies of the application and documents need not be sent to the Bank.

faq.question: Q1. What is SBI SCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is the engagement of Specialist Cadre Officers on contract basis by State Bank of India for its Wealth Management vertical, covering 207 tentative posts, under Advertisement No. CRPD/SCO/2026-27/23.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in SBI SCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 207 tentative vacancies across seven posts: 1 Zonal Head, 5 Regional Head, 24 Relationship Manager–Team Lead, 9 Investment Specialist, 4 Investment Officer, 91 VP Wealth, and 73 AVP Wealth.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date for online registration and payment of fees is 25-09-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for SBI SCO VP Wealth and AVP Wealth posts?
faq.answer: Both posts require a graduate degree from a Government-recognized University or Institution, with an MBA or relevant post-graduation and NISM/CFP/CFA certifications preferred.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Age limits vary by post, as on 31-08-2026: 35–50 years for Zonal Head/Regional Head, 28–42 for RM-Team Lead/Investment Specialist, 28–40 for Investment Officer, 26–42 for VP Wealth, and 23–35 for AVP Wealth.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application fee for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The fee is ₹750 for UR/EWS/OBC candidates. SC, ST, and PwBD candidates are exempted from the fee.

faq.question: Q7. What is the CTC for SBI SCO Wealth Management posts?
faq.answer: CTC upper ranges vary by post, from ₹27.10 lakh for Investment Officer up to ₹97 lakh for Zonal Head, and are negotiable based on the candidate's experience and current emoluments.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for SBI SCO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection involves shortlisting, followed by one or more rounds of personal/telephonic/video interview carrying 100 marks, and individual CTC negotiation with shortlisted candidates.

faq.question: Q9. Can a candidate apply for more than one SBI SCO post?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates can apply for more than one post if they otherwise fulfil all eligibility criteria for each post applied for.

faq.question: Q10. What is the contract period for SBI SCO Wealth Management posts?
faq.answer: The contract period is 5 years, renewable for another 4 years at the Bank's discretion, subject to conditions the Bank may stipulate.
